He is best known for his work on the determination of the circumference of the Earth based on the measurement of the Earth's shadow during a lunar eclipse.

Shaykh al-Faizel bin 'Abd al-Qadir al-Jilani (1077-1166 AD): A prominent Sufi saint and scholar known for his spiritual teachings and influence on the development of the Qadiriya Sufi order.
